lines.text: After Jehoiada died, Judah's officials paid homage to the king, and Judah abandoned the house of the LORD for idols.
The LORD sent prophets, but the people would not listen, and then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah.
By the king's order, Zechariah was stoned at the Jordan River, asking the LORD to call Joash to account.

wrong_details.true: in the courtyard of the house of the LORD

lines.text: In the spring, the army of Aram entered Judah and sent the plunder to their king in Nineveh.
Joash's own servants killed him on his bed, and his son Amaziah reigned in his place.
